summary: Official Tamaulipas sources evidence state cadastral custody and digital-cartography responsibilities, plus a public Servicios Catastrales route. Current anonymous access was blocked by an anti-bot challenge or timed out before a safe parcel ID plus full polygon response could be verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Spanish discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-6308-ciudad-victoria.json.
requestOutcomes: The official Finance services page returned HTTP 200 and exposed the Servicios Catastrales iframe. The iframe and direct IRCT page returned anti-bot hCaptcha/perfdrive challenges; the official SIETam cartography page timed out; the official Victoria PDF is general cartography rather than parcel geometry. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS-disable action was used.
